# Security reports

To report a suspected security vulnerability in Mole for Mac or Mole for Windows, email [hi@mole.fit](mailto:hi@mole.fit) with the affected app version and the steps to reproduce it. Send security details privately rather than posting them in a public issue or discussion.

## 安全问题

发现 Mole for Mac 或 Mole for Windows 的安全问题，可以把 App 版本和复现步骤发到 [hi@mole.fit](mailto:hi@mole.fit)，问题详情走邮件，不发到公开 Issue 或讨论里。
